response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced (~19-20 years) and versatile full-stack/software engineer with strong craftsmanship and open-source credentials, but his profile does not match the Director-level Principal Engineer, AI Strategy role. His career has been spent as a Senior/Staff-level individual contributor without evidence of director-level strategic influence, customer/partner advisory work, or thought leadership in AI. His AI exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work in his current role, with no advanced AI degree, no demonstrated AI products/platforms, and no cloud strategy experience.
strengths: Extensive (~19+ years) hands-on engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Strong track record of open-source contribution, teaching, and community engagement (talks, workshops, courses)
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling shows some current relevance to AI space
concerns: No advanced degree or deep specialization in AI/ML; only a few months of applied AI-agent work
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff IC roles, not Director-level strategic leadership or executive influence
No evidence of advising strategic customers/partners or driving cloud/AI product strategy at scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI depth and recognized AI expertise
No director-level strategic leadership or customer advisory experience
Long, broad engineering experience meeting minimum tenure requirement
